intro.en: Talking about proportions and percentages, with an equality comparison.

texto.en:
- **La mayoría de** + plural group: **la mayoría de los jóvenes**. The verb may agree with *mayoría* (**vive**) or with the people in the group (**viven**).
- Fractions: **la mitad de**, **un tercio de**, **una cuarta parte de** + group or amount.
- Put a determiner before a percentage: **el 20 %**, **un 20 %**, **este 20 %**. The text uses **el** for its specified survey figure. With a plural group after **de**, the verb can be singular or plural: *el 20 % va/van al gimnasio*.
- **Uno de cada tres** means one in every three; use **una** with an all-feminine group. Also: **casi todos**, **muy pocos**, **nadie**.

In conversation, **un montón de** means loads of. To describe figures, use **aumentar/disminuir** or **subir/bajar**. For a comparison, say **el doble de** or **la mitad de** + an amount.

**Igual de** + adjective/adverb + **que** compares equal degrees: *Es igual de alto que su padre*; *leen igual de poco que las mujeres*. It is similar to **tan … como**. To name a source, use **según**: *según la encuesta*.

frases.es: Según una encuesta reciente, la mayoría de los españoles pasa más de tres horas al día delante de una pantalla.
frases.en: According to a recent survey, most Spaniards spend more than three hours a day in front of a screen.
analisis: más de tres horas al día

frases.es: Casi todos tienen móvil, y uno de cada tres lo mira nada más despertarse.
frases.en: Almost all of them have a mobile, and one in three looks at it as soon as they wake up.

frases.es: La mitad de los jóvenes hace deporte cada semana.
frases.en: Half of young people exercise every week.

frases.es: En cambio, solo el veinte por ciento de los mayores de sesenta años va al gimnasio.
frases.en: On the other hand, only twenty per cent of people over sixty go to the gym.
analisis: de los mayores de sesenta años

frases.es: Los hombres leen igual de poco que las mujeres: menos de un libro al mes.
frases.en: Men read just as little as women: less than a book a month.
analisis: igual de poco que las mujeres
menos de un libro al mes

frases.es: Muy pocos dicen que tienen tiempo libre suficiente.
frases.en: Very few say they have enough free time.

pregunta.en: Complete: most young people live with their parents.

bloques.frase: La mayoría ___ los jóvenes vive con sus padres.

pregunta.en: Use the definite article for this previously identified survey figure.

bloques.frase: ___ veinte por ciento de los alumnos.

El.en: Use el for this definite, specified figure.

Un.en: Un is possible in other contexts, but the prompt asks for the definite article.

Los.en: The percentage is singular; use the definite article el.

pregunta.en: Complete: he is just as tall as his father.

bloques.frase: Es igual ___ alto que su padre.

de.en: Igual de plus adjective plus que.

pregunta.en: According to the survey, what proportion of young people exercise each week?

Twenty per cent.en: That figure is for people over sixty.

explicacion.en: De cada is out of every.
De cada is out of every.

traduccion.en: Very few have enough free time.

bloques.frase: El veinte por ciento de los estudiantes ___ cada día.

entrenan.en: The plural verb agrees with the students; singular agreement with el veinte por ciento is also possible.

entrena.en: This agrees with el veinte por ciento as a whole, but the prompt asks for plural agreement.

entrenas.en: Use third person to agree with el veinte por ciento or los estudiantes.

texto.en:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (100–120 words).** Write a paragraph describing the habits of people in your country, using la mayoría, la mitad, uno de cada… and percentages.

**Speak (about 2 minutes).** Present aloud the results of a real or invented survey among your friends.
